description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between model accuracy and the o_pop frequency, comparing initial and final accuracy values across different frequencies. The x-axis represents the o_pop frequency, scaled linearly from 1 to 19, with each value multiplied by 10^4, and is labeled “o_pop frequency (x10^4)”. The y-axis represents accuracy, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, and is labeled “Accuracy”. The plot contains two lines: the “Initial Accuracy” is shown as a green line with solid triangles, and the “Final Accuracy” is shown as a blue line with solid circles. The green line begins at approximately 0.33 accuracy at an o_pop frequency of 1, dips to its lowest point of approximately 0.27 at frequency 7, and then rises to approximately 0.52 at frequency 13 before declining slightly to approximately 0.41 at frequency 19. The blue line begins at approximately 0.65 accuracy at frequency 1, peaks at approximately 0.88 at frequency 9, and then generally declines with some fluctuations, ending at approximately 0.88 at frequency 19. Both lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability in the measurements.
